summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB bundle unrelated to package purpose
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is itself variable-name obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, lookup-object string indirection) and downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run a sibling file. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using string-array rotation, numeric literal tables, and mangled identifiers — heavily obfuscated content that has no relation to the package's advertised JSON-to-HTML schema translation purpose (which is implemented separately under `src/html_converters/*`). Fetching an alternate language runtime purely to execute an obfuscated sibling payload at `npm install` time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades Node-focused scanners. The payload fires automatically on default install via the `preinstall` lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
